about: The Wheel of Whatever: what a chance space can do, and the Fair Bulletins read out at the start of each round (round 5). `w` is the weight. `do` is read by js/sim/board.js spin(); `{p}` is the player who landed, `{o}` another player picked at random. A bulletin's `mods` are explained at LAST_CALL in board.js. Round 12: `short` is the few words on a Wheel of Whatever segment (events) or the one-second line of a bulletin; `do: item` hands over a prize card (`item` names one, else random); `board` holds the live events' numbers.

events.text: {p} found a roll of tickets under the bench. +5 tickets!
{p} dropped their popcorn AND their tickets. -4 tickets.
Free samples! Everyone gets 2 tickets.
{p} wins the ring toss and {o} pays up. {p} takes 3 tickets from {o}.
{p} feels generous and hands {o} 3 tickets.
The crowd sweeps {p} along. Forward 3 spaces!
{p} took a wrong turn at the candy floss. Back 2 spaces.
A magician's trick! {p} and {o} swap places.
The ticket inspector checks whoever has the most. They hand 4 tickets to {p}.
Grand prize! {p} wins a ribbon outright!
{p} finds a golden die in the hay! Next roll uses two dice.
{p} steps in candy floss. Sticky shoes: next roll is only 1 to 3.
{p} whacks a piñata! {p} grabs 4 tickets, everyone else scrambles for 1.
{p} dresses up as the ticket collector. Everyone with more than 10 tickets pays 2.
Lost and found! Whoever has the fewest tickets gets 5. That's {o}.
A pony ride carries {p} all the way to the next prize booth!
The carousel spins too fast! Everyone is flung 2 spaces forward.
{p} bets 5 tickets on a coin flip...
The fog machine goes off! When it clears, everyone is somewhere else.
{p} wins a balloon animal. +2 tickets and a big smile.
A seagull swoops off with {p}'s tickets! -3.
Raffle time! The lucky number belongs to {o}, who wins a ribbon!
{p} left their coat at the gate and runs back for it. (+5 for passing the gate.)
{p} gets their face painted as a tiger. Roar! +1 ticket.
{p} buys everyone candy floss: 1 ticket each from {p}'s pocket.
{p} and {o} drop their ticket rolls in a puddle and pick up the wrong ones. They swap tickets!
{p} rings the strongman bell. {o} lost the bet and pays 2 tickets.
Trick or treat! {p} gets a full-size candy bar. +4 tickets.
Trick! A rubber spider drops on {p}, who drops 2 tickets.
A flutter of friendly bats! Everyone is swept 1 space forward.
Boo! A ghost scares {p} and {o} so much they swap places.
A friendly witch gives {p} a lucky broom ride. Next roll uses two dice!
{p} stirs a bubbling cauldron of sweets: +3 for {p}, +1 for everyone else.
The giant pumpkin contest! The judges pick {o}'s pumpkin: a ribbon for {o}!
{p} works the claw machine and grabs a prize card!
{p} finds a Double Die card stuck to a candy apple.
A bat drops a Whoopee Cushion card at {p}'s feet.

bulletins.title: Ribbon Sale!
bulletins.text: Prize ribbons cost only 7 tickets this round.

bulletins.title: Mud Season
bulletins.text: The puddles are deeper: they cost 5 tickets this round.

bulletins.title: The Parade Passes!
bulletins.text: Everyone dances 2 spaces forward with the band.

bulletins.title: Double Prize Day
bulletins.text: This round's minigame pays double tickets!

bulletins.title: Piñata Party!
bulletins.text: A giant piñata bursts over the fair. Everyone grabs a handful of tickets.

bulletins.title: Underdog Hour
bulletins.text: Whoever is in last place gets a golden die (two dice next roll).

bulletins.title: Golden Ducks
bulletins.text: Duck pond prizes are doubled this round.

bulletins.title: Duel Day
bulletins.text: Dice duels take 6 tickets this round. Roll high!

bulletins.title: A Lovely Evening
bulletins.text: Nothing unusual is happening at the fair tonight. Probably.

bulletins.title: Trick or Treat Night!
bulletins.text: Every ticket stand hands out extra candy: they pay 5 this round.

bulletins.title: The Haunting Hour
bulletins.text: The ghosts are restless: puddles are ghostly goo and cost 4 this round.

bulletins.title: Costume Parade!
bulletins.text: Everyone marches 2 spaces forward in their costumes.

bulletins.title: Candy Rain
bulletins.text: Candy falls from the sky! Everyone grabs a handful of tickets.

bulletins.title: Free Shortcut
bulletins.text: The shortcut has no toll this round.

bulletins.title: Strongman Day
bulletins.text: The High Striker pays double this round. Swing hard!

bulletins.title: Prize Card Party
bulletins.text: The Fortune Teller hands everyone a free prize card.

bulletins.title: Big Pot Night
bulletins.text: The Steal or Share pot is 12 tickets this round.

board.about: Round 12 live events (read by js/sim/board.js). striker: the High Striker's prize for a power at least `min` (0-100; `item` = a prize card too). pact: Steal or Share's pot and what both stealing costs each. fortune: what the Fortune Teller's cards can be (weighted). items: the prize cards a player holds and plays before rolling (the ids are rules in board.js useItem; names and text are here).

trap.name: Whoopee Cushion
trap.text: Leave it on your space: the next rival to stop there pays you 4 tickets.

pass.name: Express Pass
pass.text: Instead of rolling, ride straight to the next Prize Booth (and buy a ribbon if you can).
